description: National Railway Network (NRWN) is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. The National Railway Network (NRWN), version 1.0 focuses on providing a quality geometric description and a set of basic attributes of Canadian rail phenomena. Coverage: Government of New Brunswick. The portal files it under the publisher Government of New Brunswick | Gouvernement du Nouveau-Brunswick. Its tags are national, railway, network, Government information, nationale. It offers 13 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, HTML, KML, KMZ. The portal shows 2026-01-28 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - New Brunswick. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
